limitations: These are experimental package versions; the exact owner-approved release candidate does not exist.
The recent prior 178 and current 181 packages contain identical executable bytes, so that replay proves a package version transition rather than binary migration.
The older 167 to 181 replay changes executable bytes but skips intervening versions; it does not prove every upgrade path.

The probe tests version, MCP discovery, pre-network loopback/invalid-URL denial, removal and residue. It does not test user configuration migration, native-client calls after upgrade, other platforms or arbitrary network traffic.
